promotion_rule: A concept may first live in an expansion. Promote it into data/nodes.json only after its definition, evidence class, source status and graph role are clear.
relationship_rule: Expansion relationships must distinguish historical, observed, mathematical, comparative and project-interpretive edges.
maintenance_rule: Every file under data/expansions/ must appear here or be explicitly excluded by path policy. Status must distinguish active referenced research, research reservoir, migration candidate, superseded seed and promoted/archived material; filename age alone is not a deletion reason.
